description: Fork of exp648 (tiny SOTA = 1.4827 @ 61.34M, bs=16, E=192) with E doubled to 384. Keeps the 6x per-layer residual_lut architecture (per exp648, not the single-final variant of exp649). Head-to-head vs exp650 (single-final, E=384, ~86.5M) at matched param count and E. Side effects: tok_emb_E doubles (+6.29M); out_proj n_outputs doubles (+18.87M total). Expected total params ~86.50M. residual_lut input dim doubles → anchor coverage halves further (was mean=4 at E=192, now ~2 reads/pos/layer; expect many per-layer dead positions). Reference: exp648 = 1.4827, exp650 in progress, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
